```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| output: false

# Reading in data
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here(
  "data",
  "ejscreen",
  "EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb"
))

holc <- sf::st_read(here::here(
  "data",
  "mapping-inequality",
  "mapping-inequality-los-angeles.json"
))

crashes <- read_csv(here::here(
  "data",
  "SWITRS_LA",
  "Crashes.csv"
))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Transforming the CRS o
holc <- st_transform(holc, crs = st_crs(ejscreen))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| output: false
crashes_sf <- crashes |>
  filter(!is.na(LONGITUDE) & !is.na(LATITUDE)) |>
  rename(long = LONGITUDE, lat = LATITUDE) |>
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("long", "lat"),
    crs = 3857
  )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
# Verifying CRS match
if (st_crs(crashes_sf) == st_crs(ejscreen)) {
  print("it's a match!")
} else {
  print("still not a match")
}
```


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-align: center

hist_red <-
  tm_basemap("Esri.WorldStreetMap", zoom = 10, alpha = 0.55) +
  tm_shape(holc) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "grade",
    fill_alpha = 0.7,
    fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(
      values = c("#2a5f1a", "#0155af", "#f9d03b", "#900011"),
      value.na = "grey50"
    ),
    col = "grey20",
    lwd = 0.3,
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "HOLC Neighborhood Grades",
      position = tm_pos_in("right", "bottom"),
      bg.color = "white"
    )
  ) +
  tm_compass(position = c("left", "bottom"), size = 1.5) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("right", "bottom")) +
  tm_layout(
    main.title = "Home Owners' Loan Corporation Neighborhood Grades in Los Angeles, CA (1939)",
    text.fontfamily = "sans",
    style = "natural",
    outer.bg = TRUE,
    outer.bg.color = "white",
    frame = TRUE,
    legend.text.size = 0.5,
    legend.title.size = 0.6
  )

hist_red
```

```{r}
la_cnty <- ejscreen |>
  filter(CNTY_NAME == "Los Angeles County")
```

```{r}
la_cnty_cent <- st_centroid(la_cnty)
```

```{r}
holc_census <- st_join(la_cnty_cent, y = holc, join = st_within)
```

```{r}
holc_cens_summ <- holc_census |>
  group_by(grade) |>
  summarise(n_bg = n()) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(
    pcnt_cens_holc = (n_bg / sum(n_bg)) * 100
  ) |>
  mutate(grade = ifelse(is.na(grade), "No HOLC grade", grade))

```

```{r}
holc_cens_summ |>
  select("grade", "pcnt_cens_holc") |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = md("Census Block Groups Per HOLC Grade")) |>
  cols_label(
    grade = "HOLC Grade",
    pcnt_cens_holc = "Percent of Census Block Groups"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = pcnt_cens_holc,
    decimals = 2,
    pattern = "{x}%"
  )
```
